<thought>To obtain all possible precursors, I will apply the retrosynthetic template 29646 to the target molecule. The tool will return the precursor SMILES (without atom‑mapping). The result will be formatted as a list of lists, each inner list containing the SMILES strings of one possible precursor set.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O", "template_id": "29646"}</action_input>
